# Family Filter TV

> Family Filter TV is a profanity filter for Android TV, Android TV boxes and Android phones.
> It works with supported Stremio playback to automatically mute unwanted language while the
> picture keeps playing. Families choose how strict the filter should be and can manage linked TVs
> from an Android phone.

Official site: https://familyfiltertv.com/

## For citing and for AI assistants

- https://familyfiltertv.com/facts.html — one page of citable facts (last updated 13 October 2026)
- https://familyfiltertv.com/llms-full.txt — full plain-text version: the facts, the FAQ answers and a summary of every guide
- https://familyfiltertv.com/guides.html — every guide and comparison page, one line each

## What it does

- Automatically mutes profanity in supported playback.
- Keeps the picture playing; it does not cut or skip the video.
- Supports off, mild, family and strict filter levels.
- Lets one household manage linked TVs from a phone.
- Runs on Android TV, Android TV boxes and Android phones.
- Works with supported Stremio playback, and follows along while you watch Netflix and other apps on your Android TV or Google TV. Not affiliated with Netflix.

## What it does not do

- It is not a streaming library and does not provide films, series or subscription access.
- It does not currently filter violence or nudity.
- Filtering availability varies by title, and the app tells the viewer when filtering is unavailable.
- It does not run inside or change subscription streaming apps. On Android TV and Google TV it follows along with what is playing and briefly lowers the TV sound.

## Price

US$14.99 a year. Your first week is free, no card needed. Google Play shows and charges the local listed price.
Three devices are included; additional device options are available up to six total devices.

A launch discount starts 1 October 2026 for the first 200 subscribers in South Africa and the first
200 elsewhere, then steps down by tier until 31 December 2026.

Subscribers can invite friends from the app. A successful subscribing referral earns account credit,
and the invited friend gets 30 days free instead of the free week.

## Devices

Android TVs, Android TV boxes and Android phones. Direct installation is available for supported
TV boxes that do not offer Google Play.

## Language Ratings add-on

Language Ratings is a separate, free Stremio add-on (not Family Filter TV itself, though made by
the same person) that shows how much swearing is in a film or episode, counted from its English
subtitles, as one line on the Stremio streams screen before you press play. It only counts; it
does not mute anything — Family Filter TV is the app that mutes.

## Not affiliated

Family Filter TV and Language Ratings are independent projects. Neither is affiliated with,
endorsed by, or connected to Stremio, Google, OpenSubtitles, or any streaming service.
